import pandas as pd

# File paths for the source CSV files
source0_path = "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length1_73/test_0.csv"
source1_path = "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length1_73/test_1.csv"

# Load Source 0 (2017 data)
df_2017 = pd.read_csv(source0_path)

# Load Source 1 (2015 data)
df_2015 = pd.read_csv(source1_path)

# Rename columns in df_2015 to match target schema suffix "_15"
df_2015_renamed = df_2015.rename(columns={
    'Happiness Rank': 'Happiness_Rank_15',
    'Happiness Score': 'Happiness_Score_15',
    'Standard Error': 'Standard_Error_15',
    'Economy (GDP per Capita)': 'Economy_15',
    'Family': 'Family_15',
    'Health (Life Expectancy)': 'Life_Expectancy_15',
    'Freedom': 'Freedom_15',
    'Trust (Government Corruption)': 'Trust_15',
    'Generosity': 'Generosity_15',
    'Dystopia Residual': 'Dystopia_15'
})

# Rename columns in df_2017 to match target schema suffix "_17"
df_2017_renamed = df_2017.rename(columns={
    'Happiness_Rank_17': 'Happiness_Rank_17',
    'Happiness_Score_17': 'Happiness_Score_17',
    'Whisker_High_17': 'Whisker_High_17',
    'Whisker_Low_17': 'Whisker_Low_17',
    'Economy_17': 'Economy_17',
    'Family_17': 'Family_17',
    'Life_Expectancy_17': 'Life_Expectancy_17',
    'Freedom_17': 'Freedom_17',
    'Generosity_17': 'Generosity_17',
    'Trust_17': 'Trust_17',
    'Dystopia_17': 'Dystopia_17'
})

# The 2017 source does not have 'Region', so we will get 'Region' from 2015 data

# Merge the two datasets on 'Country'
df_merged = pd.merge(
    df_2015_renamed,
    df_2017_renamed,
    on='Country',
    how='inner',
    suffixes=('_15', '_17')
)

# Select and order columns as per target schema
target_columns = [
    'Country',
    'Region',
    'Happiness_Rank_15',
    'Happiness_Score_15',
    'Standard_Error_15',
    'Economy_15',
    'Family_15',
    'Life_Expectancy_15',
    'Freedom_15',
    'Trust_15',
    'Generosity_15',
    'Dystopia_15',
    'Happiness_Rank_17',
    'Happiness_Score_17',
    'Whisker_High_17',
    'Whisker_Low_17',
    'Economy_17',
    'Family_17',
    'Life_Expectancy_17',
    'Freedom_17',
    'Generosity_17',
    'Trust_17',
    'Dystopia_17'
]

# Ensure all target columns exist in the merged dataframe
missing_cols = [col for col in target_columns if col not in df_merged.columns]
if missing_cols:
    raise ValueError(f"Missing columns in merged dataframe: {missing_cols}")

df_target = df_merged[target_columns]

# Convert data types to match target schema
df_target = df_target.astype({
    'Country': 'string',
    'Region': 'string',
    'Happiness_Rank_15': 'Int64',
    'Happiness_Score_15': 'float',
    'Standard_Error_15': 'float',
    'Economy_15': 'float',
    'Family_15': 'float',
    'Life_Expectancy_15': 'float',
    'Freedom_15': 'float',
    'Trust_15': 'float',
    'Generosity_15': 'float',
    'Dystopia_15': 'float',
    'Happiness_Rank_17': 'Int64',
    'Happiness_Score_17': 'float',
    'Whisker_High_17': 'float',
    'Whisker_Low_17': 'float',
    'Economy_17': 'float',
    'Family_17': 'float',
    'Life_Expectancy_17': 'float',
    'Freedom_17': 'float',
    'Generosity_17': 'float',
    'Trust_17': 'float',
    'Dystopia_17': 'float'
})

# Write the result to the target CSV file
output_path = "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length1_73/target_multisource_cot.csv"
df_target.to_csv(output_path, index=False)
